BEFORE_TOKEN.admissible: ordinary glyphs and UNK with positive mass; never BOS or EOS
BEFORE_TOKEN.rng: one U53 from conditional admissible distribution

INSIDE_TOKEN.admissible: ordinary glyphs, UNK, EOS; never BOS
INSIDE_TOKEN.transition: glyph or UNK emission -> INSIDE_TOKEN; EOS -> TOKEN_COMPLETE
INSIDE_TOKEN.rng: one draw under the route's fully specified categorical sampler

symbols.EOS: not emitted; forbidden before a glyph; terminates after one or more glyphs
symbols.UNK: sampleable model outcome; emits U+FFFD and counts as one glyph
symbols.ordinary: sampleable and emitted as its NFC UTF-8 scalar

unresolved: Generator B algorithms and draw allocation
